_why: P5-005 requires recorded wire fixtures. This is NOT a recorded provider response. It reproduces the documented shape of a `history.list` response that has NO further pages.
_the_point_of_this_fixture: This is the ONLY kind of response a caller may advance a durable cursor from. The reference says that if you receive NO `nextPageToken` there are no updates to retrieve and 'you can store the returned `historyId` for a future request'. So `historyId` is present on every success while `nextPageToken` appears only mid-walk -- the two are NOT mutually exclusive (unlike Calendar's `nextPageToken`/`nextSyncToken` pair), and a reader that treated them as a pair would take its cursor from the wrong field. This fixture is the second half of that pair.
_sanitized: No real message text, request id, or address appears here.
